mods.name: WW Prince - Model, Water Sword and Voice (OpenJade)
mods.author: beatsdtx06
mods.description: OpenJade 0.5.1 ONLY. WW Prince model, Water Sword from New Game, enhanced damage and boss-only blue aura, plus the approved 93-line English AI voice preview. Import and Apply in PoP Mod Manager 2.1.2, then launch. No setup scripts or extra installer. Disable older WW Prince packages; do not stack editions. Steam is not supported.
